title: nicotiana australis
intro: Nicotiana australis, commonly known as the Tasmanian flowering tobacco, is a flowering plant species in the nightshade family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its bronchodilatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Nicotiana australis include its use as an antispasmodic and an anti-inflammatory, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as asthma and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include tropane alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
